$comment: The source of sf-toast's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/toast (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

status.summary: What the message reports, in the shared status vocabulary. The words this component used before — default and primary — are still accepted and mean neutral and info.

supporting-text.summary: Concise supporting text at the normal body size.

action-text.summary: Visible label of the one optional action.

action.summary: Stable action value emitted in sf-toast-action.

closable.summary: Render an explicitly named close action.

close-label.summary: Localized accessible name of the close action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Close message" in English).

duration.summary: Explicit lifetime in milliseconds. Zero keeps the message until dismissed.

action.summary: data-action or data-toast-action of the pressed control; empty when neither is set.
Emitted once when the optional enabled action is activated.

close.summary: Emitted once before token-based dismissal removes the toast owner.
Same as dismiss: emits sf-toast-close and removes the toast.

show.x-summary: Says a message: text (or the assembly's word for code and count, §11.2) becomes the heading, tone the status

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: role is the host's role attribute when it says status or alert, written on the toast's root; without one the toast is a plain group inside the notification region, which announces

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-toast for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (setting rows), host-attribute (no shim), manifest-only (the DOM name does not change).

rows.summary: Legacy name for status, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the toast (status or alert) and written on its root; no shim
the DOM name stays; detail keeps action and loses the elements toast and trigger
rows.summary: Emitted once when the optional enabled action is activated.

rows.note: the DOM name stays and is cancelable now; detail is {reason}, without the elements toast and trigger
rows.summary: Emitted once before token-based dismissal removes the toast owner.

x-summary: Transient overlay feedback with semantic roles, optional action, pause-safe lifetime and dismiss behavior.
x-renamed: settings.title → heading: "title" is a property of HTMLElement.prototype (§3.1, §16 item 26), alias dated
settings.type → status: the axis's old name, alias dated
settings.role: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)

events sf-toast-action, sf-toast-close: the DOM names stay; detail carries data only (action, reason), the elements toast and trigger leave it (§8); close is a cancelable request and closed the fact (§19.3)
x-decisions: own-verb-words: action is a verb of the toast alone (the person pressed the toast's action button); its word is lang events.action.label.
version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0: title and type are dated aliases, close becomes cancelable, closed and show are added.
a11y-role: the toast takes the host's role attribute when it is status or alert and writes it on its root; without it the notification region that holds the toast announces (SF.notify).
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus the statuses, an action and a timed toast; probe.json drives the close and action buttons and Tab.
css-variables: the eight public variables the sheet already reads (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).

side-effects: none. sf-toast draws where it stands; the toast layer of the one stack is the notification region SF.notify places it in (core/js/notify.js, kind toast: it takes no keys and no presses).

events: the shared class toast (component/toast/js/_toast.js) sends sf-toast-close and sf-toast-action on its root with the elements in detail; sf-toast stops them at its host and sends its own from the host with data only. The class close is cancelable now, so a refused sf-toast-close keeps the toast. Reasons: close (its own close button), api (dismiss(), close(), the timer).
show: an assembly's rule says a message through the toast: text (the word of code and count, §11.2) becomes the heading and tone the status.
version 1.1.1: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.2: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

lifetime.persistent: duration=0; required for messages whose action or content must not be missed
lifetime.timed: positive duration; pauses while pointer or keyboard focus is inside the toast
lifetime.dismiss: token motion completes before the visual owner is removed

live_region_guidance.assertive: role=alert only for a newly inserted urgent error
live_region_guidance.polite: role=status for a newly inserted non-urgent result
live_region_guidance.static: omit a live-region role when the toast is present on initial page load

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-toast for concise transient overlay feedback that does not block the current task.
do_not: Do not use Toast for persistent inline guidance; use Alert
Do not auto-dismiss a message whose content or action must not be missed
Do not use role=alert for routine success feedback
Do not choose a semantic type only for its color
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-toast status="success" title="Saved" supporting-text="Your changes are available." role="status" close-label="Close message"></sf-toast>

accessibility.focus: Native actions use focus-visible; a timed toast pauses while focus is inside it.

setState.summary: Writes each key as its kebab-case attribute: false, null, undefined or empty removes it, true sets it empty, anything else is stringified.

onAction.summary: Adds a listener for sf-toast-action; the handler is called with (action, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

onClose.summary: Adds a listener for sf-toast-close; the handler is called with (detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

role.description: Live-region role for dynamically inserted feedback only.
